label: sec:planck-info-unit
html: The local per-step Reeb share \hbar_q(p) = 1 - q(p)^{-1} sets the minimal quantisable grain of an information unit at a point p \in M. An elementary information unit at p scales with the substrate parameter as \hbar_q(p) --- the fraction of one Reeb circuit traversed per elementary connection step, distinct from the unit-normalised full circuit \hbar_q \cdot t_P = 1.
